public_rationale: The public-release claim holds. OpenAI's February roadmap still described GPT-5 as forthcoming, and its official introduction followed in August. Public speculation was documented by April 2023, consistent with an approximate two-year wait. This does not establish that OpenAI itself promoted GPT-5 continuously for two years.
limitations: The assessment concerns public availability, not internal prototypes.
The rhetorical description of publicity is not separately endorsed.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI still has not released GPT-5 after two years of hype.

statement.excerpt: And of course, there is still no GPT-5, even after two years, of hype, bullshit, and cryptic hints.

our_interpretation: No GPT-5 means no publicly released model bearing that name by March 1, 2025; it does not mean no internal development.
Two years is an approximate reference to the preceding period of GPT-5 anticipation.
The insults and characterization of publicity are rhetoric, not independently measurable commitments.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous release records and company statements place GPT-5 in the future at the time of the post.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An authenticated public GPT-5 release occurred on or before March 1, 2025.
